title: Error Taxonomy for MP3→Sheet Pipeline: Raise Your Glass
reference_source: MuseScore 'Raise y_our glass - Violin Version' by Music ABC

summary.dominant_problem: Systematic octave-low pitch selection (~8 semitones below reference)

categories.name: Octave Selection Error
categories.description: The DP melody path resolver selects candidates one octave below the actual vocal melody, producing notes 12 semitones too low.

examples.reference: Ab4 Ab4 Bb4 Ab4 Eb4 Eb4 (median=68)
examples.explanation: DP selected Ab3 instead of Ab4 — exact octave displacement

examples.reference: Bb4 Bb4 Bb4 Ab4 Bb4 Ab4 (median=70)
examples.explanation: Pre-chorus Bb4 pattern resolved as Bb3 — full octave error
Sustained chorus note Eb5 resolved as Eb4

categories.likely_root_cause: melody_path DP resolver — register scoring cannot overcome confidence/duration advantage of lower-octave harmonic candidates from Basic Pitch
contributing_factors: Basic Pitch generates strong low-octave harmonics as candidates
The upper_quartile_pitch is only 68 (Ab4) — already biased low
Register bonus (vocal mode) targets upper quartile but with insufficient weight
Local register context is contaminated by abundance of low-octave candidates
Octave smoothing post-cleanup is too conservative to fix systematic octave errors

categories.name: Wrong Pitch Center (non-octave)
categories.description: Selected pitch is significantly wrong but not a clean octave error. Typically 7-10 semitones too low.

examples.reference: Ab4 Ab4 Bb4 Ab4 Eb4 Eb4 (median=68)
examples.explanation: Opening measure — Ab4 melody rendered as Ab3+C4 (mixed wrong octave + wrong pitch)
Rising melody C5 rendered as lower Eb4/C4

examples.reference: C5 Bb4 Ab4 Bb4 Ab4 F4 Eb4 (median=68)
examples.explanation: Descending passage shifted down — contour partially preserved but wrong register

categories.likely_root_cause: Combination of octave error and pitch drift from merging/refinement
contributing_factors: DP resolver selecting from wrong octave track
Pitch refinement's neighbor correction nudging toward wrong (low) center
Vocal abstraction merging notes across octave boundaries

categories.name: Over-Merged Notes (Too Sparse)
categories.description: The generated output has far fewer notes per measure than the reference, indicating excessive merging of distinct melodic events.

examples.reference: 7 notes (F4 Eb4 Ab4 Ab4 Ab4 Bb4 Ab4)
examples.explanation: Entire measure of eighth-note melody collapsed into single quarter note

examples.reference: 6 notes (Ab4 Eb5 C5 Ab4 Eb5 C5)
examples.explanation: Chorus hook pattern (Ab-Eb-C arpeggiation) completely lost
Both wrong pitch and excessive merging compound

categories.likely_root_cause: Vocals-mode config overrides increase merge tolerances significantly
contributing_factors: merge_gap_ms=200 (vs default 120) merges notes that should be distinct
consolidate_max_gap_ms=300 (vs default 150) absorbs too many events
phrase_max_short_note_ms=300 treats notes up to 300ms as 'short' for merging
The reference has ~4.4 notes/measure but generated has ~2.4 notes/measure
Vibrato suppression + phrase smoothing compound to eliminate real melodic motion

categories.name: Pitch Drift
categories.description: Pitch is moderately wrong (3-5 semitones off) — not a full octave but still clearly incorrect.

examples.explanation: Descending line Eb4-Db4-C4 resolved as repeated Ab3
Transition zone — mix of correct and wrong-octave notes

categories.likely_root_cause: Pitch refinement or vocal abstraction choosing wrong representative pitch for merged segments
contributing_factors: Duration-weighted pitch selection can drift toward harmonics
Stability-weighted scoring may favor sustained lower harmonics
Neighbor correction can propagate errors from adjacent wrong-octave notes

categories.name: Implausible Melodic Interval
categories.description: Large jumps (12+ semitones) between consecutive notes that are not musically justified.

examples.explanation: Octave jump at verse/chorus boundary where melody is continuous in reference

categories.likely_root_cause: Stream switch in DP resolver at section boundary
contributing_factors: DP resolver switches between octave tracks at phrase boundaries
Pitch refinement's interval smoothing limited to 7-semitone threshold
octave_flip_penalty_weight (6.0) not strong enough at boundaries

categories.name: Note Explosion (Too Dense)
categories.description: Generated output has more notes than reference in specific measures.

examples.explanation: Chorus arpeggiation pattern — actually the reference may be simplified here; the generated output captures more detail from the arrangement

categories.likely_root_cause: Vocal abstraction insufficiently merging in this specific section
contributing_factors: Fast arpeggiation pattern exceeds vibrato detection thresholds
The reference violin arrangement may be intentionally simpler here

melody_path.description: The DP resolver is the PRIMARY source of errors. It systematically selects the wrong octave for melody notes, and this error propagates through all downstream stages.

vocal_abstraction.description: Over-aggressive merging eliminates real melodic detail. Vocals-mode config overrides (merge_gap_ms=200, consolidate_max_gap_ms=300) are too aggressive.

pitch_refinement.description: Neighbor correction and interval smoothing cannot fix octave-level errors and may propagate them. The corrections applied (13 neighbor, 2 interval) may be nudging notes toward wrong centers.

phrase_smoothing.description: Compounds merging from vocal abstraction. Less directly responsible but contributes to density reduction.

candidate_notes.description: Not directly causing errors, but the candidate pool is heavily biased toward lower-octave harmonics, which is the root enabler of the DP resolver's octave errors.
